ballot_measures.title: Prohibit Taxes or Fees on Miles Traveled in Motor Vehicle Amendment
ballot_measures.description: Prohibit the state and local governments from imposing taxes or fees based on vehicle miles traveled and from enacting rules to monitor or limit vehicle miles traveled without the person’s consent.

ballot_measures.title: Prohibit Race- or Ethnicity-Based Preferential Treatment in Public Education
ballot_measures.description: Amends the Arizona Constitution to bar the state, its agencies, and public educational institutions from requiring endorsement of preferential treatment or discrimination based on race or ethnicity.

ballot_measures.title: Voter Identification and Citizenship Voting Requirements
ballot_measures.description: Amends the Arizona Constitution to require citizenship to vote or register, require government-issued ID to vote, and ban foreign-national contributions in Arizona elections.

ballot_measures.title: Limit Local Tax Rate on Groceries to 2% of Base Price and Require Voter Approval to Increase Tax Rate Measure
ballot_measures.description: Prohibit local government from imposing or increasing a tax on the sale of food items without voter approval and cap the tax rate at 2%.

ballot_measures.title: Designate Drug Cartels as Terrorist Organizations and Require State DHS to Address Threats Measure
ballot_measures.description: Declare drug cartels to be terrorist organizations.

ballot_measures.title: Restrict Restrooms, Locker Rooms, and Sports Teams to Birth Sex
ballot_measures.description: Requires schools and athletic associations to restrict restrooms, locker rooms, and other private spaces to the corresponding sex (defined as biological sex on the original birth certificate) and restricts sex-designated sports participation accordingly.

ballot_measures.title: Prohibit New Photo Traffic Enforcement Systems
ballot_measures.description: Amends state law (A.R.S. Title 28) to prohibit installing or using new photo traffic-enforcement systems; local governments with systems in place by Dec. 31, 2026, may continue only with voter approval.

ballot_measures.title: Require Large School Districts to Spend 60% on Direct Instruction
ballot_measures.description: Requires school districts with more than 7,500 students to spend at least 60% of their operational budget on direct instruction, with the auditor general defining direct instruction.
